tournamentEntry.shareText: Discover TournArena, the app to follow your competitions.

hero.title: Follow a competition
hero.hint: Pools, knockout brackets, schedule and live standings.

register.title: Create my account
register.lede: Create your organizer account to manage your tournaments directly from the app.
register.sentBody: A confirmation email was sent to {{email}}.
register.sentHint: Open the link inside to activate your account, then come back here to log in.
register.errorConflict: An account already exists with this email.
register.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

errors.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 10 characters.

login.title: Log in
login.lede: Log in to your organizer account.
login.errorVerify: Verify your email before logging in.
login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired, please sign in again.

sessionTimeout.title: Still there?
sessionTimeout.body: Your session will expire in {{seconds}} seconds due to inactivity.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.lede: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, an email with a reset link was just sent.
forgotPassword.sentHint: Open the link it contains to choose a new password, then come back here to log in.
forgotPassword.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

list.title: My tournaments
list.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

account.title: My account
account.dangerZoneIntro: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.
account.deleteWarning: This action is irreversible. Your account will be deleted immediately. If you are the sole administrator of an organization, it will be deleted along with all its tournaments, teams, and data.
account.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

wizard.title: New tournament
wizard.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

infos.title: General information
infos.venuePlaceholder: Search a stadium, gym or address…
infos.venueSearchFailed: Address search unavailable: the typed name will be used as is.

teams.title: Participating teams
teams.minHint: At least 3 teams are needed to move on to the next step.
teams.errorAdd: Couldn't add this team, please try again.
teams.errorRemove: Couldn't remove this team, please try again.
teams.pastePlaceholder: One club per line (or comma separated)
teams.errorPaste: Could not save these names, try again.

structure.title: Competition format

poolsKnockout.name: Pools then knockout
poolsKnockout.desc: Group stage, then the top teams face off in a knockout bracket.

knockoutOnly.name: Single-elimination knockout
knockoutOnly.desc: One loss and a team is out. Fast, a single winner.

league.name: League (round-robin)
league.desc: Every team plays every other team once.

structure.editOnWebHint: To change the structure, use the web admin (Structure).

calendar.title: Match schedule
calendar.lede: Automatically generate the schedule from the teams and format you chose.
calendar.noScheduleHint: No schedule to generate for this format -- a knockout bracket fills in match by match, as results come in.
calendar.editLaterHint: Exact times and venues can be adjusted later from "My tournaments".
calendar.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.
calendar.regenerateSummary: Change the date, time or fields

publish.paymentHint: If your free tier is exceeded, a secure Stripe payment will be offered before publishing.
publish.planActive: Annual subscription active until {{date}}. Every publication of yours is free.
publish.planNone: Billed per publication based on team count. The annual subscription makes every publication of yours free.
publish.subscribeError: Could not confirm your subscription. Please try again shortly.
publish.errorVisibility: Could not save the tournament visibility.
publish.errorCheckout: The server could not prepare the payment.
publish.errorProduct: This purchase is not available on the App Store right now.
publish.errorPurchase: The purchase did not go through.
publish.errorConfirm: Purchase made, but the server did not confirm it. Try again: you will not be charged twice.
publish.republishHint: Your changes are already visible. Republish to confirm them: if they exceed what has been paid, payment will be requested.
publish.republishPaymentNeeded: These changes require a payment of {{amount}} ({{teams}} teams) to be republished.
publish.republishFree: No payment needed: these changes are covered by your plan.

done.title: Tournament published!
done.body: {{name}} is live and ready to receive results.
done.pendingPaymentBody: A secure payment tab has opened. Once payment is complete, your tournament will be published -- check back from My tournaments to see its status.
done.paymentBlockedIosBody: This tournament goes beyond the free tier. To complete payment and publish it, go to tournarena.com from a browser -- not available in the iOS app.
done.republishedBody: {{name}} has been republished with your changes.

scores.title: Scores
scores.addCategoryFirst: Add a category first on the web admin.
scores.addPhaseFirst: Add a phase first on the web admin.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to manage this tournament's scores.
errors.loadGeneric: Unable to load this page's data.
errors.enterBothScores: Enter both scores (home and away) before saving.
errors.matchForfeited: This match is declared a forfeit -- undo the forfeit before entering a score.
errors.saveGeneric: Unable to save this score, check the values entered.
errors.penaltyShootoutRequired: A penalty shootout is required to validate this drawn match.
errors.enterEverySet: Enter both scores of every set before saving.

standings.title: Standings
standings.addCategoryFirst: Add a category first on the web admin.
standings.knockoutOnlyNote: This tournament is in Knockout format: generate the bracket on the web admin first.
standings.addPoolPhaseFirst: Add a pool phase first on the web admin.
standings.addGroupFirst: Add a pool to this phase first.
standings.bracketNotGenerated: The bracket hasn't been generated for this phase yet.
standings.finalRankingEmpty: The final ranking will be available once the knockout brackets are completed.
standings.tieQuestion: -- who should rank ahead of the others?
standings.chooseTeamAheadLabel: Choose the team to rank ahead

quickPlateau.title: Create an event
quickPlateau.intro: One day, several teams rotating on your fields. "Team 1, 2…" teams, fields, pools and the schedule are created in one go; you rename the teams right after.
quickPlateau.name: Plateau name

preview.invalid: You need at least 2 teams per pool and 1 field.

errors.invalid: This format is not possible: check teams, pools and fields.

live.title: Match day
live.teamsUnknown: teams known after the previous phase

errors.shiftConflict: This shift would overlap another slot on a field.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.topDefenseNote: Goals conceded, teams with at least 3 matches.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose what you want to receive for your favorite teams.

permission.deniedHelp: Turn them on for TournArena in your phone's settings.

test.sent: Notification coming in a few seconds: lock your phone, or stay in the app, to see the banner.
test.denied: Can't do it: notifications are not allowed.

teams.title: Per favorite team
teams.empty: No favorite team yet. Add one with the star on a team's page.

form.reminderHint: Scheduled ahead: works even with the app closed and the phone locked.
form.liveHint: These alerts arrive while the app is open or in the background.

display.title: Display
display.ios: To see banners on the locked and unlocked screen: Settings > Notifications > TournArena, then tick Lock Screen, Notification Center and Banners.
display.android: To see banners: Settings > Apps > TournArena > Notifications, then turn on "Match alerts".
display.web: Notifications are available in the mobile app.
